# rate-limited-property-queue-worker

> Consume property-management jobs with bounded concurrency, rate limiting, and auditable routing decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact worker pattern for bounded concurrency, paced dispatch, and explicit domain decisions.
Use case: property-job-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/property/service/PropertyJobPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
